dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent pale margins provide high visual contrast against the dark bodies of the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct horizontal transition boundary exists where the uniform gray-brown nape meets the patterned upper mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive imbricate pattern of dark feather centers with pale buff-to-white fringes across the dorsal tracts.
